title: Burbank → Chania
blurb: West to Crete — long flight, late landing.
plan: Flew Burbank–San Francisco–Frankfurt–Athens–Chania. Boots on Crete late Tuesday.

title: Chania
blurb: Old harbour, market mornings, easy first days.
plan: Harbour walks, old-town coffee, Saturday market. No car yet — stayed close and ate well.

title: Paleochora
blurb: South coast with the car — Elafonisi in the mix.
plan: Picked up the car in Chania, drove the south-coast roads to Paleochora, swam Elafonisi.

title: Douliana
blurb: Mountain village nights inland from the north coast.
plan: Three quiet nights in the hills — village walks, taverna tables, a north-coast swim when we wanted one.

title: Elounda
plan: Two nights in Elounda — Spinalonga by boat, easy evenings by the water.

title: Heraklion
blurb: Last Crete stretch — car returned, city days.
plan: Dropped the car. Agios Minas Cathedral (family stop), old town, market, last Cretan dinners before the ferry.

title: Heraklion → Santorini
blurb: Morning Seajets hop to the caldera.
plan: Worldchampion Jet, club class — Heraklion 8:00, Santorini 9:35, then up from Athinios.

title: Santorini
blurb: Caldera light, Oia anniversary, black-sand Perissa.
plan: Three nights — Oia for the anniversary, Perissa beach, Fira wander, dinners with a view.

title: Santorini → Athens
plan: Eurochampion Jet 2 — Santorini 12:55, Piraeus 18:30, into Athens for the night.

title: Athens
blurb: Acropolis, markets, macarons, then two slow sick days.
plan: Acropolis and museum, Plaka and Monastiraki, Krinos loukoumades, Ladurée and the best pho in town — then competitive Χουζούρι before the flight home.
